title: Sonshine by the Sea | 4BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Sonshine by the Sea is a luxury 4BR Seagrove home with a private pool and trail access. Enjoy 4 adult bikes and a 4-block walk to the beach. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: Sonshine by the Sea by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 496 San Juan Avenue, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Walk to Seaside, WaterColor, and the best of 30A from this inviting Seagrove Beach retreat with a private pool. Welcome to Sonshine by the Sea—your inviting 30A retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Ideally located, you’re just a short walk or bike ride to Seaside, WaterColor, and the very best of 30A. This thoughtfully designed home is filled with warmth and character, featuring original artwork created by the owner—adding a personal, artistic touch you won’t find anywhere else. Perfect for families or two groups traveling together, the home offers two spacious master suites with ensuite baths and a layout that comfortably allows guests to spread out between floors while still gathering with ease. Enjoy your own private pool, unwind after a day at the beach, or hop on one of the complimentary bikes to explore the Longleaf Greenway Trail, where it begins right outside your door. The sugar-white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast are just 4 blocks away, with easy access via both San Juan Beach Access and Santa Clara Regional Beach Access, which offer parking, restrooms, lifeguards, and wheelchair accessibility. Whether you're here for beach days, bike rides, or simply time together, Sonshine by the Sea offers a peaceful, family-friendly escape in one of 30A’s most sought-after locations. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Walk or bike to Seaside, WaterColor & the best of 30A -*Private heated pool with outdoor lounge seating & grill area -Designed for two families with 2 master suites + separate living spaces -Gourmet kitchen with 9-burner gas stove, fully stocked for group meals -Original artwork throughout the home by the owner—warm, curated coastal feel -High-speed fiber internet + Smart TVs for streaming or remote work -Two large covered porches (upstairs & downstairs), including foosball upstairs -Outdoor shower—perfect after beach days -4 complimentary bikes + direct access to the 11-mile Greenway Trail -Easy walk to beach (0.4 miles) via San Juan & Santa Clara Beach Access -Three dedicated parking spaces -Two separate HVAC systems (upstairs & downstairs) for personalized comfort *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 3.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub/Separate Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Open Floor Plan Living Room -Pool Lanai, Patio and Outdoor Dining -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with 2 Bunk Sets (XL Twin/XL Twin) -Sleeper Sofa (Full) -Family Room Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Biking and Hiking Trails Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
